title: One-Minute Arrive
intro: One minute, six small steps. Come back to the room you are in.

steps.text: Pause what you are doing and let your hands rest.
Feel your feet on the floor and your weight in the chair.
Look around the room and name one thing you had not noticed.
Take one slow breath in and a slow breath out.
Let your shoulders drop a little.
Decide the very next small thing you will do.

closing: One minute, done. Off you go.
